release is a collection of many small improvements that add up to a smoother everyday experience when editing and searching your tree. Lists and gallery media can be **reordered by drag & drop**, the **date editor** explains each date type, and titles are edited right in the heading. The **search** shows results as you type, the lists get **more filters**, and **tasks** are improved throughout. On the map, the historical map now **follows the year slider in real time**.

## New Features

- **Drag & drop** to reorder list rows and gallery media in edit mode, with a long press on touch screens. Attributes, addresses, URLs, associations and place names can now be reordered too #1617, #1623 (closes #777)
- The **date editor** is reworked, with chips for the date type, a hint for each type, and checks for invalid days and months #1639
- **Search as you type**, with prefix matching. Search results, the object picker and the map search show more details, e.g. birth and death of people and the first line of notes #1620
- **More filters** for the lists: people by name, families by father, mother or child name, sources by author, places by type and repositories by type. A GOQL field with syntax highlighting replaces the GQL field #1629, #1633
- **Improved tasks**: the task list gets the advanced filter, a status menu on each row and sorting by priority. On the task page, tasks can be deleted with undo and made private. Fixes many bugs in both #1618, #1625, #1628, #1630 (closes #961)
- The **historical map follows the year slider in real time**, without delays while dragging #1634
- Opacity slider for your own maps by @petermgrund in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1615 (closes #1575)
- The fan chart colours by the surname of the birth name by @lukasganster in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1645 (closes #1546)
- Click the title of a task, source, repository or media object to edit it directly in the heading #1624, #1626

## Other Changes

- The buttons above the lists are in one toolbar, with the active filters in a row below #1622
- The symbols ⚭ and ⚮ look the same on every device #1647
- The map requires a browser with WebGL2 support #1634

## Bug Fixes

- Fix the relationship chart overloading the server when changing the maximum degree of separation #1636
- Use the selected symbols, e.g. text abbreviations, in the relationship chart by @jayhemnani9910 in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1616 (closes #1611)
- Fix removing a citation or note that is listed more than once #1619
- Translate the buttons and labels that stayed in English on the connection error, password reset and registration screens #1643

## New Contributors

- @jayhemnani9910 made their first contribution in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1616

release continues the move to Material Web components, with restyled data tables, a reworked snackbar and many bug fixes. The media view now opens media **in the lightbox** and shows **video thumbnails**. Under the hood, the release images contain [Gramps Web API v3.25](https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web-api/releases/tag/v3.25.0), whose Docker image is **less than half its former size** and which uses less memory, with faster search and lists. Semantic search is removed. With the standard Docker setup, no action is needed. :jack_o_lantern: 

## New Features

- The media view opens media **in the lightbox**, which steps through the results, and media can be **selected and deleted** like in the other list views #1596
- Videos get a **thumbnail**, and audio and video also play in the lightbox, in blog posts and in notes #1600
- **Select all** objects matching the filters in the list views, and delete large selections in the background #1591
- The chromosome browser can be **downloaded as SVG** #1579
- Changing your own password **keeps you logged in** by @jon99nelson-svg in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1587
- Show why an import failed #1589, and when the search index is being built #1588

## Modernization

- All remaining text fields, buttons, progress indicators and the snackbar now use Material Web components. Part of #541. #1592, #1593, #1595, #1603
- The snackbar is replaced by a new component that shows above dialogs and can be swiped away #1603, #1606
- Restyled data tables with a sticky header #1598, and a compact page footer #1594

## Bug Fixes

- Fix the fan chart running out of memory with many generations #1608, #1609 (closes #1532)
- Precache the main bundle in the service worker, thanks to @giang17 #1607 (closes #1584)
- Fix typing in the note editor on older browsers by @jon99nelson-svg in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1590 (closes #1543)
- Fix zooming and the mobile title in the lightbox, and show PDFs on Android #1605 (closes #1419)
- Show translated labels in selects #1581 (closes #1580)
- Fix many bugs in the chromosome browser and DNA views #1577, #1579
- Hide the password form when local sign-in is disabled #1569 (closes #953)
- Keep the context of earlier questions in follow-ups to the AI chat #1610

## New Contributors

- @jon99nelson-svg made their first contribution in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1587

release continues the work on the map: places can now bring their own **map files**, so the boundaries of a parish or a route in KML, GeoJSON or GPX appear right on the map, **Wikidata buildings** can be saved to your tree with one click, and all map labels are now shown **in your language**. Beyond the map, the object lists get an **advanced filter** that combines any of the Gramps filter rules, admins can **create and restore backups** directly in the app, and you can **link several sign-in methods** to your account. Three new contributors joined with a long list of bug fixes. Welcome! :rocket:

Several of the new features rely on new endpoints in [Gramps Web API v3.24](https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web-api/releases/tag/v3.24.0), the server component included in the release images. They degrade gracefully on older backend versions.

## Map View

### Map files of places

When you select a place on the map, the **KML, GeoJSON and GPX files** attached to it as media objects are drawn on the map, e.g. the boundaries of a parish or a route. This also works for places without coordinates. While a place is selected, its files are listed in the layer switcher under "Your maps" and can be switched off there.

Implemented in #1524, #1552

### Save Wikidata buildings as places

The details of a Wikidata building have a new **Save as place** button, which opens the new place form prefilled with the building's name, type, coordinates and a link to Wikidata. If the building is already in your tree, the button opens the existing place. This lets you use the historical buildings collected in [Domus](https://domus.genealogy.net/) in your own tree.

Implemented in #1528

### Labels in your language

The labels of the base map and the historical map are now shown **in the language you selected in Gramps Web**, for all its languages, and fall back to the local name. Closes #1460.

Implemented in #1521, #1522

## Advanced Filter

The filter panel of the object lists has a new **Advanced filter** button, which opens a condition builder for everything the filter facets can't express. Conditions are the filter rules known from Gramps desktop, picked from a searchable list. They can be combined in groups with *All conditions*, *Any condition* or *Exactly one condition*, and groups and conditions can be nested and negated. Each parameter gets a matching input, e.g. a date field, a tag selector or the object selector for IDs.

Active facet filters open in the builder as conditions, and a simple filter goes back to the facet pills when you're done. The rules are shown in your language with Gramps Web API v3.24.

Implemented in #1506

## Backups

The admin settings have a new **Backups** section. You can **create, download and delete backups** stored on the server, and **restore** from a stored backup or an uploaded file. Before restoring, you choose what to restore (data, tree settings and users) and get a preview of the changes. The restore from a Gramps XML file moved into the same upload, so the Danger Zone now only contains "Delete all objects". Managing backups needs a new permission and Gramps Web API v3.24.

Implemented in #1544

## Linked Sign-in Methods

If your server uses single sign-on (OIDC), you can now **link and unlink sign-in methods** under Settings > Account, e.g. to sign in to an existing account with Google or Microsoft. Part of #770, implemented by @scotCW in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1547

## Other New Features

* In edit mode, a person without media shows a profile picture placeholder with a menu to upload or select a media object, and the first image in the gallery is marked as the profile picture. Closes #1414. Implemented by @lukasganster in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1525
* When another task is already running on the tree, e.g. an import or a reindex, starting a new one now shows a clear message and the running task with its progress. Finished tasks in the notification log read "Task completed" or "Task failed", and clicking a failed task shows its error. #1535
* When the limit for media archive exports is reached, the error message now shows the configured limit. #1534
* The first-run wizard no longer asks for the e-mail settings, which are set in the server configuration. By @scotCW in https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web/pull/1511
